source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The checked getter reads doNotDisturb first and returns true immediately when set. Otherwise it reads dndStart/dndEnd; equal endpoints leave false, a same-day schedule uses start-inclusive/end-exclusive comparison, and an overnight schedule uses before-end or at/after-start. It computes the current minute in local time. This records the exact accepted implementation, not validation that these preference keys represent Do Not Disturb on every macOS version. The complete getter creates four CFStrings without releasing them; native ownership cleanup remains an explicit source gap rather than a measured leak. No native or schedule-boundary test ran.
title: The macOS notification DND getter combines explicit state with a local-time schedule
